actual.titulo: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines • The Tazara
actual.descripcion: The Tazara ║ The Tanzania-Zambia-Railway is one of Africa's most ambitious infrastructure projects; it connects the inland with the coast of East Africa and means independence from the surrounding apartheid-ruled countries of East Africa.

siguiente.titulo: World's Most Dangerous Railway Lines • The Bernina Express
siguiente.descripcion: The Bernina Express ║ A look at the Bernina Express, which fights its way from Switzerland to Italy over 196 bridges and 55 tunnels; the path leads it through deep valleys, wild gorges and over the eternal ice of the Graubünden Alps.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Mauve: The Fake Color That Made Our Modern World
lista.descripcion: Mauve: The Fake Color That Made Our Modern World ║ In 1856, a chemistry student accidentally created a strange substance with a rich purple hue; Mauve takes over the fashion industry, make food look more appetizing, and enable stunning advances in medicine.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Vanilla: The Bean That Shaped the Future of Food
lista.descripcion: Vanilla: The Bean That Shaped the Future of Food ║ In 1841 on the small island of Réunion, a 12-year-old slave did something no one had done before; the vanilla bean takes the world by storm, sparking the artificial flavor revolution and forever changing how we eat.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Barcode: How the Barcode Shaped Our Modern Economy
lista.descripcion: Barcode: How the Barcode Shaped Our Modern Economy ║ Barcodes have radically changed global commerce, helping fuel the rise of everything from massive companies like Walmart to world powers like China, and it all started with a man daydreaming on a beach in 1949.

lista.titulo: The Lightbulb Moment • Florida: How Real Estate Rogues Invented Florida as We Know It
lista.descripcion: Florida: How Real Estate Rogues Invented Florida as We Know It ║ Florida wasn't always the Sunshine State; in the 1920s, an army of real estate boosters set out to redefine Florida from an economic backwater to a ritzy vacation destination, sparking a land boom the likes of which America had never seen before.

lista.titulo: Growing Up • The Honey Seekers
lista.descripcion: The Honey Seekers ║ At an altitude of 3,000 meters, Mopti climbs vertiginous rock faces of the Himalayas to gather honey from the biggest bee species on the planet: the giant Apis laboriosa bee.

lista.titulo: Bright Now! • Growing Up Hadza
lista.descripcion: Growing Up Hadza ║ The Hadzabe of Tanzania, considered one of the last hunter-gatherer tribes on the planet, pass the knowledge of this way of life to the next generation.

lista.descripcion: Two million visitors go to the Great Smoky Mountains National Park yearly; people come from all over the world to catch a glimpse of the blue haze that gives the park its name or a black bear scurrying into the woods.

lista.titulo: Beyond the Spotlight • Shaquille O'Neal
lista.descripcion: Shaquille O'Neal ║ Shaquille O'Neal, who went from being poor and bullied to NBA stardom, reveals how his stepfather taught him the valuable lesson that "true pressure is not knowing where your next meal is coming from.

lista.titulo: Beyond the Spotlight • Kristen Bell
lista.descripcion: Kristen Bell ║ Actress Kristen Bell recounts how her nurturing nature and her good works, such as co-founding No Kid Hungry, was sparked when she was age 19 and helped deliver two babies during a missionary trip to a clinic in Brazil.

lista.titulo: Beyond the Spotlight • Samuel L. Jackson & LaTanya Richardson Jackson
lista.descripcion: Samuel L. Jackson & LaTanya Richardson Jackson ║ Actors/spouses Samuel and LaTanya Jackson have fought for civil rights around the globe, but their greatest satisfaction comes from handwritten thank you notes from children they have supplied with books.

lista.titulo: Beyond the Spotlight • LeVar Burton
lista.descripcion: LeVar Burton ║ Inspired by his mother to be "of service," LeVar Burton entered the seminary at 13 years old; after deciding the Church didn't have the answers to his life questions, he changed his focus to theater arts and became known for Roots and Star Trek.

lista.titulo: Beyond the Spotlight • MrBeast
lista.descripcion: MrBeast ║ Jimmy Donaldson, also known as MrBeast, is the world's first digital philanthropist; after becoming obsessed with YouTube at a young age, Jimmy built a viral video empire based on the joy he gets from helping others.

lista.titulo: Beyond the Spotlight • Joe Namath
